title: Web-content prompt injection during research (ResearchBot, dvaa chat)
summary: The agent's system prompt is sent to an attacker-controlled endpoint. ResearchBot holds no other sensitive data.

LC.rationale: Attacker-controlled language arrives via a fetched web page (ingested content), not the direct user message, and drives a security-relevant outbound call.

CP.rationale: The injected page content is used within a single request; ResearchBot keeps no durable store and other chat agents answer only the latest user turn.

AP.rationale: The effect stays inside the ResearchBot component; the only boundary crossed is the outbound exfiltration request, which is the impact itself, with no propagation into other agents, tenants, or policy domains.

RH.rationale: The path is deterministic scripted code with no evaluator, verifier, or reward channel anywhere in the handler, so no proxy objective is reachable.

ES.rationale: The web_fetch and http_post bindings execute real outbound HTTP with attacker-influenced URLs and payload contents that are not independently constrained.

agentic_applicability.rationale: The lab models a research agent persona (ResearchBot) that autonomously fetches user-supplied URLs and acts on page content; in LLM mode a model generates the reply, though the exfiltration path itself remains scripted.
